name: Open Facilitator Workspace Link (linkd)
description: Installs the ofac-linkd headless Link runtime (self-contained Node bundle), the headless supervisor entrypoint, and a unit that enrolls + connects the workspace directly to a Facilitator (no Gateway in between). Install order is irrelevant: units carry numeric prefixes and every Feature writes distinct files.

facilitatorUrl.description: Facilitator base URL the unit connects to.

endpointId.description: Link endpoint identity for this workspace.

team.description: Team slug the endpoint enrolls into (must match the manifest ownerTeam).

manifest.description: Capability manifest JSON published at enroll. linkd requires a readable manifest; a missing file is a terminal config exit by design.

mode.description: Delivery handler mode: echo replies, stub acks silently.
